tabs_label: Sign in, register or set up your own server
pair_compare: Compare it with the code on the watch. If it differs, do not pair: the link may have been tampered with.
personal_lead: Send recordings from your watch to a server you run yourself instead of to PigeonDrop. This covers only receiving the recordings: speech recognition, Telegram and listening on this page need a PigeonDrop account.
personal_blocked_key: Open this page by scanning the QR code on your watch (Settings → Connection → Pair via QR code). The code carries the key that protects what you type here. If your watch shows no such code, or this message stays, enter the address and token in the PigeonDrop settings in the Zepp app on your phone instead.
personal_blocked_crypto: This browser cannot encrypt on this page. Open it over a secure connection (https) in an up-to-date browser.
personal_token_hint: Make a token just for the watch: one that can only add recordings and can be revoked.
personal_err_code: This code is no longer valid. On the watch open Settings → Connection → Pair via QR code and scan the new QR code.
personal_err_crypto: This browser could not encrypt the settings, so nothing was sent.
personal_done: Now confirm on the watch. It shows the address below and saves nothing until you press “Use this server”. If the address is wrong, press Cancel there and start again from its QR code.
personal_privacy_1: Your server address and access token are encrypted in your browser before they are sent. The key is only on your watch: it is in the QR code, after the “#”, and browsers never send that part to any server. Our server only passes the encrypted message on to your watch. It keeps it in memory (never in the database, the logs or backups) for at most 10 minutes and deletes it as soon as the watch has picked it up. You can check this yourself: in your browser’s developer tools (Network tab) the request contains only encrypted data.
personal_privacy_2: What this cannot protect against: if our server or this page were tampered with, it could serve code that reads what you type before it is encrypted. The code of the project is open, but you cannot see what is actually running on the server. If you do not want to trust us with this, enter the settings in the PigeonDrop settings in the Zepp app on your phone instead: then nothing passes through our server.
personal_privacy_3: Either way, make a separate token for the watch that can only add recordings and can be revoked.
address_err.not_text: Enter the address of your server.
address_err.empty: Enter the address of your server.
address_err.too_long: The address is too long: 200 characters at most.
address_err.bad_characters: The address must not contain spaces or line breaks.
address_err.has_query: Leave out everything from a ? on.
address_err.has_fragment: Leave out everything from a # on.
address_err.has_credentials: Do not put a user name or password in the address.
address_err.bad_host: The part after https:// is not a valid server name. Use a name such as example.com or an IPv4 address.
address_err.bad_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
address_err.bad_path: The path may only contain letters, digits and . _ ~ - between slashes.
token_err.too_long: The token can have 256 characters at most.
token_err.bad_characters: The token must not contain spaces or line breaks.
telegram_blocked: Telegram says the bot is blocked in this chat, so recordings are not delivered there. Link the chat again.
telegram_wait: Open the link and press “Start” (it is valid for 10 minutes). This page will notice the link by itself.
telegram_privacy: The voice message and its transcript are sent to Telegram’s servers. You can unlink at any time.
storage_warning: Storage is almost full. When it runs out, the oldest recordings are deleted automatically while new ones are still accepted. Delete recordings you do not need now if you want to choose what to keep.
note_before: The text under each recording is produced by a program (NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, licence
note_after: ) and may contain mistakes, especially with whispering, noise and names.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
err.invalid_invite: The invitation code is not valid, has expired or was already used.
err.invalid_email: This does not look like an email address.
err.weak_password: The password is too short: at least 12 characters.
err.invalid_user_code: There is no such code, or it has expired. Open the pairing screen on the watch again.
err.forbidden_origin: The request was refused: it came from another site.
err.not_found: Not found: it may have been deleted already.
err.conflict: This recording cannot be transcribed again now: the list may be out of date.
err.unavailable: Telegram is not available right now. Try again later.
revoke_confirm: Revoke “{name}”? This watch will stop sending recordings.
skip.not_decodable: The recording could not be read, so it cannot be transcribed.
skip.too_long: The recording is too long to transcribe.
no_playback: Could not convert it for playback; the original can be downloaded.
telegram_not_linked: Not linked. Link a chat and new recordings from your watch will arrive there as a voice message with its transcript.
telegram_bad_link: The server returned a link that was not expected. Do not open it.
delete_all_confirm: Delete all recordings for good? This cannot be undone.
pair_done: Done. The watch will get access within a few seconds.
sign_in_to_pair: Sign in to pair the watch.
